cc:Work.dc:description: PARTIAL REPLAY: these panels evaluate both stored coefficient sets only on the public bundled thermal-expansion, Li elastic and LASL shock subsets. They do not represent the complete 164-row approximate global reconstruction: restricted local legacy inputs are not redistributed, the Zha block is a surrogate, and original weights remain unresolved. The two dependent reference parameters are recomputed using the same documented thermodynamic constraints. RMS values apply only to the individually named public subsets.
